label: 017-structure-locations
argv: import pathlib,re; [print(p+"\n"+"\n".join(str(i)+": "+s for i,s in enumerate(pathlib.Path(p).read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig").splitlines(),1) if p in [".gitignore","README.md","Essentials Engine wiki.url"] or (p==".rubocop.yml" and re.match(r"^[A-Za-z]",s)) or (p=="LICENSE" and (s.startswith("Section") or re.match(r"  [a-n]\. ",s) or s.startswith("Creative Commons is not"))))) for p in [".gitignore",".rubocop.yml","Essentials Engine wiki.url","README.md","LICENSE"]]
